criteria.statement: Open WebUI starts from the com.kitty.openwebui login service with no shell attached
criteria.evidence: launchctl list shows com.kitty.openwebui running; /health returns {"status": true}

criteria.statement: the service process never inherits PYTHONPATH, PYTHONHOME, PYTHONSTARTUP, or the repo working directory
criteria.evidence: ps eww on the launchd pid shows only PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1; lsof cwd is ~/kitty-services/openwebui; import mcp resolves to the venv SDK

criteria.statement: exactly one admin@localhost account exists and start collapses duplicates idempotently
criteria.evidence: 6 rows before, 1 after; dedupe refuses when a duplicate owns rows

criteria.statement: no account is ever left at role=pending with nobody able to approve it
criteria.evidence: DEFAULT_USER_ROLE=admin; forcing the live row to role='pending' and restarting returned it to admin with no intervention

criteria.statement: a real provider stream reaches the user through Open WebUI and terminates with [DONE]
criteria.evidence: POST /api/chat/completions returned 'launchd live', TTFT 3.80s, done=true

criteria.statement: chats, messages, and the account survive a full service restart
criteria.evidence: chat 'Persistence probe' and its message present after launchctl bootout + install-autostart

criteria.statement: a provider failure shows the user a plain-language cause instead of a blank reply
criteria.evidence: with the revoked provider re-pinned, Open WebUI rendered the routing message and the stream closed cleanly

criteria.statement: status and doctor report actionable state and fail loudly
criteria.evidence: doctor passes clean; smoke exits 1 with 'Gateway refused the streaming turn — routing: ...'

criteria.statement: backup then restore returns the earlier state and refuses while the service runs
criteria.evidence: post-backup chat removed by restore, pre-backup chat retained; restore refused while running

criteria.statement: rollback removes the login service and returns the existing Kitty UI without tearing down gateway or LiteLLM
criteria.evidence: UI serving 200 on :4000; com.kitty.gateway and com.kitty.litellm still loaded

criteria.statement: no secrets, runtime data, databases, logs, or machine-specific paths added to the repository
criteria.evidence: .env is gitignored; backups live under ~/kitty-services/openwebui/backups

criteria.statement: Open WebUI lists Kitty Auto, Fast, Think, Code, and Vision
criteria.evidence: GET /api/models returned all five ids after restart

criteria.statement: no two menu rows resolve to the same upstream model
criteria.evidence: test_menu_entries_are_distinct_models; kitty-sonnet and kitty-default both served deepseek-v4-pro before

criteria.statement: the vision route names a model the provider actually has
criteria.evidence: mistral/mistral-small-latest is not an OpenRouter id; replaced with mistralai/mistral-small-3.2-24b-instruct, verified live

criteria.statement: Kitty Auto lets the classifier pick the tier; a pinned choice is not second-guessed
criteria.evidence: auto on a deep message routes to kitty-sonnet; kitty-think on a trivial message stays on kitty-think

criteria.statement: each menu id streams a real answer through Open WebUI
criteria.evidence: auto 7.5s, fast 5.5s, think 4.7s to first token

criteria.statement: Kitty Image is not listed until it works
criteria.evidence: image generation runs through image_jobs, not chat completions; deferred to the image slice

criteria.statement: Open WebUI is given a deliberate menu of tools, not the whole Gateway spec
criteria.evidence: /tools/v1/openapi.json lists 6 operations; the Gateway's own spec lists 200+

criteria.statement: the tools are behind the Gateway secret
criteria.evidence: unauthenticated GET /tools/v1/projects returns 401

criteria.statement: each tool returns real data from the function that owns it
criteria.evidence: all six return 200 against live stores

criteria.statement: the Builder tool never returns the initiative corpus
criteria.evidence: returns queue counts plus at most 10 attention items; raw snapshot is 425KB

criteria.statement: the model emits a real tool call and Kitty forwards the schemas
criteria.evidence: delta.tool_calls names builder_status; request_trace reports tool_execution=caller

criteria.statement: Kitty memory and context are reachable from the chat surface
criteria.evidence: search_memory returns the stored preference; the mem0 user_id bug that broke every search is fixed

criteria.statement: a short set of purposeful agents exists and is created idempotently on start
criteria.evidence: daily-kitty, research, coding, tutor, builder-operator in the model table; ensure_agents runs on every start

criteria.statement: each agent streams a real answer through Open WebUI
criteria.evidence: daily-kitty 3.7s, coding 3.0s

criteria.statement: Open WebUI opens on Daily Kitty with the agents pinned
criteria.evidence: DEFAULT_MODELS=daily-kitty, DEFAULT_PINNED_MODELS lists the five

criteria.statement: Tutor is reachable as a tool and reports an empty library as an answer, not a crash
criteria.evidence: ask_tutor returns grounded:false with the fix instruction; /tutor/ask is 404 not 500

criteria.statement: the calendar is reachable as a tool and the model picks it unprompted
criteria.evidence: asked what is on the schedule, the model called calendar_today

criteria.statement: stopping the service does not leave KeepAlive racing the next start for the port
criteria.evidence: down unloads the job, reports that login startup is off, and leaves port 3000 free

criteria.statement: Gmail and GitHub tools
criteria.evidence: no such surface exists in the Gateway to expose; a tool that cannot answer is worse than no tool

criteria.statement: at least one image engine actually generates an image
criteria.evidence: openrouter engine: job created, SUCCEEDED, 497KB PNG under data/images/<job_id>/, provider recorded

criteria.statement: no second queue, gallery, or history
criteria.evidence: the hosted lane is a third engine inside image_runner.run; reuses image_jobs, artifacts, history, cancel

criteria.statement: nothing spends money until Jacob switches it on
criteria.evidence: KITTY_IMAGE_PAID_ENABLED is off by default; the refusal lands before the HTTP call and names the price

criteria.statement: diagnostics say why image generation is unavailable, not just that it is
criteria.evidence: /image/status reports each engine plus unavailable_reason with the price and the switch

criteria.statement: editing an uploaded image works end to end
criteria.evidence: the model and the code path accept image input; not yet exercised with a real photo

criteria.statement: Kitty Image is selectable from the chat surface
criteria.evidence: withheld until the lane is switched on — a menu row that fails when picked is worse than no row

criteria.statement: a photorealistic image of the James character generates on open weights, uncensored
criteria.evidence: Flux + fal identity LoRA on RunPod ComfyUI, ~29s per image; recipe in docs/plans/james-workflow-2026-08-02.md

criteria.statement: generating from an uploaded reference works
criteria.evidence: --source/--denoise in scripts/james_comfy.py; denoise 0.55 beats both LoRAs on likeness

criteria.statement: likeness is close enough to the reference photographs
criteria.evidence: both fal LoRAs give a family resemblance only; img2img holds the source composition so a new scene loses the face. Needs inpainting — item 1 of docs/plans/image-studio-next-four-2026-08-02.md

criteria.statement: the character feature actually drives generation
criteria.evidence: image_characters stores records and photos; nothing connects them to a render. Item 2 of the next-four plan

blockers.statement: AGENT_ROUTER_TOKEN in .env answers unauthorized_client_error; AgentRouter is disabled and Kitty runs on OpenRouter
Ollama serves knowledge embeddings but does not start at login; homebrew.mxcl.ollama.plist exists and is not loaded
an unattended Builder campaign with --publish --gate auto hard-resets the primary checkout to origin/main on every merge, destroying uncommitted work; the guard is on this branch but not on main
the hosted image lane works but costs ~$0.067 per image; it stays off until KITTY_IMAGE_PAID_ENABLED=1 is set in .env

known_failing_tests.note: fails identically at HEAD before any change in this branch; keyless cloud providers are still dialled
